brand_performance.scope: ChatGPT, English, Cleveland, Ohio, United States
visual_findings: Semrush frames FMD's strongest narrative as interior-first work for family vehicles, especially kids, pets, salt, odors, sickness, and biohazard messes.
The report repeatedly highlights transparent process, before-and-after proof, low upsell pressure, and east-side specialization as differentiators.
The report identifies reach rather than answer quality as the main AI-discovery problem: strong average placement when mentioned, but a small mention footprint.

competitor_research.quality_note: This broad US/all-platform query universe is not comparable to the Cleveland/ChatGPT Brand Performance universe. The zero FMD value does not contradict the eight Cleveland/ChatGPT mentions.

visual_findings: The strongest green grid points cluster around mobile car detailing, mobile detailing near me, mobile detailing service, and mobile car detailing near me, with best visible ranks of about 3 near the center/east-side operating area.
Broad car detailing and auto detailing are mostly yellow or red near the operating area and become 20+ outside the core.
Interior detailing, interior car detailing, and interior auto detailing are unusually sparse despite the brand report positioning FMD as interior-first.
The grid is a separate Semrush Map Rank Tracker measurement and should not be substituted for either the national desktop Position Tracking panel or the point-coordinate DataForSEO SERP pull.
